meaning:
A man of the Egyptians living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at Jer.37.5
Combined with par.oh (פַּרְעֹה "Pharaoh" H6547R)
§ Pharaoh-hophra = "the great house -covering evil"
the Pharaoh of Egypt at the time of the conquest by Nebuchadnezzar

elsewhere.note: Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will give Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of those who seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah…
